LanguageData.MST.labelShortComment: Short label used in compact UI. Falls back to the full label when empty.
LanguageData.MST.hitPointsComment: Base hit points of this body part before the pawn's health scale is applied.
LanguageData.MST.permanentInjuryChanceFactorComment: Multiplier for the chance that damage to this part leaves a permanent injury. 0 means never permanent.
LanguageData.MST.frostbiteVulnerabilityComment: Weight used when frostbite picks a body part. Higher means this part is more likely to be frostbitten.
LanguageData.MST.skinCoveredComment: Whether this part is covered by skin. Affects skin-layer hediffs (burns/cuts) and armor coverage.
LanguageData.MST.aliveComment: Whether the part counts as living tissue. Dead parts don't bleed and ignore flesh hediffs.
LanguageData.MST.delicateComment: Delicate parts are more easily destroyed by damage.
LanguageData.MST.beautyRelatedComment: Whether damage or disfigurement of this part affects the pawn's beauty.
LanguageData.MST.conceptualComment: Conceptual parts are non-physical and are never actually hit by damage.
LanguageData.MST.socketedComment: Socketed parts are attachment points that cannot be damaged on their own.
LanguageData.MST.destroyableByDamageComment: Whether this part can be destroyed by damage at all. If off, it is never destroyed.
LanguageData.MST.canBeVacuumBurntComment: Whether this part can be burned by vacuum (space) exposure.
LanguageData.MST.canScarifyComment: Whether this part can receive scars.
LanguageData.MST.pawnGeneratorCanAmputateComment: Whether the pawn generator may randomly amputate this part when generating a pawn.
LanguageData.MST.canSuggestAmputationComment: Whether this part can be suggested for amputation in the health tab.
LanguageData.MST.forceAlwaysRemovableComment: Force this part to always be removable via surgery, even if it normally would not be.
LanguageData.MST.spawnThingOnRemovedComment: Thing spawned (dropped) when this part is removed.
LanguageData.MST.removeRecipeLabelOverrideComment: Overrides the label of the removal recipe for this part.
LanguageData.MST.executionPartPriorityComment: Priority used when an execution picks which body part to hit. Higher is preferred.
LanguageData.MST.hitChanceFactorsComment: Per-damage-type multipliers for the chance this part is hit. Damage types not listed default to 1.
LanguageData.MST.raceLinksComment: Click to list every race whose body contains this part; click an entry to jump.
